name: Tehenhauin
canonNotes: Prophet of Sotek, greatest of the Red Crested Skinks, driven by a zeal to slaughter Skaven that is rare among Lizardmen.
Believed to renew himself like a snake shedding its skin.
voiceNotes: Zealous, fervent and prophetic; speaks of Sotek and the rat-plague.
Everything is framed as a holy war against the Skaven.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
